test_title: PYST 59: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

As I review the events of my past life, I realise how ______ are the influences that shape our destinies.
solution: The correct answer is **"subtle."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Subtle"** means not obvious or easy to detect. (बहुत गाढ़ा या चमकदार नहीं, हलका सूक्ष्‍म, बारीक) • **Example**: *This dress has **subtle**__ colours.* • The sentence implies that the influences that shape our destinies are not always easy to see or understand. • The word **"subtle"** is an adjective that describes the noun **"influences".** • The correct answer is Option 4. **Correct sentence**: *As I review the events of my past life, I realise how __**subtle**__ are the influences that shape our destinies.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • **"Artless"** means lacking skill or knowledge, or lacking in cunning or deceit. (कौशल या ज्ञान की कमी, या चालाकी या धोखे की कमी​) • **Example**: *The **artless**__ child was easily fooled by the magician's tricks.* • **"Trumpet"** is a musical instrument or a verb that means to proclaim or announce loudly. (तुरही (पीतल से बना फूँक मार कर बजाया जाने वाला बाजा, जिस पर स्‍वर-परिवर्तन के लिए तीन बटन लगे होते हैं)) __ • **Example**:* She brought her **trumpet**__ for the show* • **"Crude"** means rough or unrefined, or lacking in taste or manners. (सरल और बुनियादी; अपरिष्‍कृत) __ • **Example**:* The **crude**__ oil spill polluted the ocean.* 36:T785, The correct answer is** "the class doesn't know."**
